newsitem.title: UK: Siebe forms global automotive division.
newsitem.headline: Siebe forms global automotive division.

text.p: Controls and appliances group Siebe Plc said it had combined its automotive fluid systems and controls businesses to form a single global automotive division.
The new unit will be called Siebe Automotive Division.
Siebe said in a statement that Siebe Automotive has sales of 400 million stg and employs 6,000 people in 25 manufacturing sites across the U.S., South America, the UK, Europe and the Pacific Rim.

Siebe said the new unit would integrate and re-brand the Siebe Fluid Systems companies which make tubular fluid systems with the automotive controls businesses of Robertshaw Tennessee, Ranco North America Automotive and Ranco Europe Automotive.
Siebe Automotive's president will be James McElya, who was president of Siebe Fluid Systems.
